issue.title: bob periods brief -f md prints an empty dates segment on week Parts and raw block ids in no-linked-minutes aliases

task_type_fields.impact: Cosmetic: the brief and links pasted from it look broken, and an alias can end in a truncated block id.
task_type_fields.repro:
Two Markdown rendering glitches in `bob periods brief`:
1. `bob periods brief 2026-W41 -f md` (also W42 and W32) prints week Part lines with an empty dates segment, e.g. `- Mon Oct 5 ·  · 2h 55m · …`. `render_part` always formats `label · dates · worked`. Skip the dates segment when it is empty (bob-cli-gr.3 note #2).
2. `bob periods brief 2026-W30 -f md`, Still open "No linked minutes", prints `[[bob#^better-obsidian-image|Better Obsidian image support! ^better-obsidian-image]]` and cuts `^g-highlight…` mid-id. `still_open_section` builds that alias from `short_description(&task.text, 120)` on the raw freshness-scan text. Every other section uses `task_link` with the cleaned `IndexedTask.description`. Strip the block id and inline fields the same way `clean_task_text` does (bob-cli-gr.14 note #1).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-gr.3 and bob-cli-gr.14 found these cosmetic Markdown-rendering defects while drafting the W41 and W30 Reviews. Both are small, local fixes in brief.rs.
